tools.name: request_key
tools.description: Get a working API key now, without a sign-up form. Give the email of the person you work for: the key works at once for a few calls a day, they get one email, and when they confirm it the same key moves to the free plan of 100 calls a day. Then send it as Authorization: Bearer <key> on this server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_key, fetch_page · Private data: request_key, check_agent_readiness · Public sink: request_key · Destructive: fetch_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_key, fetch_page · Private data: request_key, check_agent_readiness · Public sink: request_key · Destructive: fetch_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
